title: hieracium lachenalii subsp. festinum
intro: Hieracium lachenalii subsp. festinum, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family, Asteraceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Hawkweed include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium lachenalii subsp. festinum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
